My dog, due to genetics, started having joint problems when he was two years old, and the prognosis wasn't very encouraging. Looking for supplements to help him, I found this brand, and with his vet's approval, I started giving him Mobility. After a few weeks, he began to improve; his pain and discomfort decreased. Then December arrived, bringing colder weather, and he was more stable, so I tried other products like Skin and Coat, which also made a difference with his constant scratching. Honestly, the brand is very good, and I've been buying it for quite some time now, so I can highly recommend it ❤️

Be careful with the promotions they offer, because after you make a purchase they'll tell you about a subscription with a higher price than the discount you got on your order. That's a deceptive or fraudulent promotion. You end up paying more, even though they try to justify it with ongoing promotions throughout the subscription year. It's a shame because they're good products, but their promotions are misleading. Be careful. Even recurring purchases don't get the real discount; they charge you for it through their "subscription."
